outcome: Removed the old Experiment browser that nothing used any more
owner_impact: Nothing changes on screen. When the unified Experiment Library replaced the old flat browser (#480), the old one was switched off but its code stayed in the workspace module. That code (about 300 lines, plus its styles) is now gone. This is slice 1 of 5 in splitting the Experiment workspace module into smaller tested parts (#554). Test now: optional quick look. Sign in, click Browse experiments, open one of your Experiments and save a revision. Everything should look and behave as before.

next.text: #554 continues with slice 2 of 5: moving the workspace's labels and sharing rules (who made a revision, location labels, who you can share with) into a small tested module. Nothing changes on screen.

technical_evidence: registry-ui-v3.js: 2,248 → 1,944 lines. Removed buildBrowser, renderBrowser, filterButton, experimentResult, experimentGroup, catalogResult, openBrowser, the browser wiring and state, and the unused experimentsInCollection.
collection-organization.js: removed the no-op simplifyExperimentBrowser hook and a loop over the retired browser's rows.
Removed stylesheet selectors naming only the retired browser's classes (registry-ui-v3.css, ui-clarity.css, ux-hardening.css). No live element uses those classes.
verify-dist now checks that the retired browser is absent, instead of pinning `const browser = null;`.
Retired 10 source-text assertions about the removed browser (6 test files). Its behaviour lives in the unified Library, covered by library-browse.test.mjs. 619 tests pass.
Style comparison of the built Lab identical to the previous production build at all four viewports.
